Where Devotion Meets the Written Word.

The Sacred Art of Writing
The NAMAH Feather Pen Set by SwissBRAND brings together the timeless elegance of a feather fountain pen and the symbolic presence of Lord Ganesha, creating a distinctive writing and gifting experience for meaningful moments.

Inspired by the symbolism of Lord Ganesha—associated with wisdom, auspicious beginnings, and positivity—NAMAH combines a gold-plated feather fountain pen, a Ganesha Ji gold-plated pen stand, two rich ink colours, a scroll, and a premium heritage presentation box.

Designed for those who believe that some words deserve to be written with meaning, NAMAH transforms ordinary writing into a memorable experience. Whether writing a blessing, prayer, special message, signature, or personal thought, every stroke becomes part of something meaningful.

Write with devotion. Write with meaning.

A Feather Fountain Pen with Timeless Character

At the heart of the NAMAH set is an elegant gold-plated feather fountain pen featuring a medium nib for a smooth and expressive writing experience.

Its distinctive feather-inspired design adds character to every writing moment, making it ideal for special messages, blessings, signatures, keepsakes, and display.

The Blessing of Ganesha
The set includes a beautifully crafted Ganesha Ji Gold Plated Pen Stand, designed to complement the feather pen while adding symbolic significance to the collection.

Ganesha represents wisdom, auspicious beginnings, and positivity, making the set especially meaningful for occasions that mark a new beginning or celebrate an important moment.

Two Inks. Countless Thoughts.
NAMAH includes two ink bottles:

  • NAMAH Red Ink
  • NAMAH Blue Ink

The two colours give you the freedom to choose the tone that best suits your writing—from personal messages and creative expression to blessings, signatures, and special notes.

The included scroll adds another layer to the writing experience, providing a dedicated space for thoughts, blessings, messages, memories, or words meant to be preserved.

NAMAH is more than a writing instrument or a decorative religious piece. It brings together faith, tradition, writing, and premium presentation in one distinctive collection.

Two Pens. 18 Shades. Endless Expression.

Bring colour, creativity, and sophistication to your writing with the Submarine Inkspire Fountain Pen Set. Designed for writers, creators, professionals, and stationery enthusiasts, this premium set includes 2 Inkspire Fountain Pens and 18 vibrant ink cartridges, giving you the freedom to explore a different colour for every idea.

Whether you're journaling, sketching, signing, taking notes, or simply enjoying the art of handwriting, Inkspire turns everyday writing into a more expressive experience.

Premium Inkspire Design

The Inkspire Fountain Pen features a sophisticated lacquered finish with a distinctive textured grip, combining contemporary aesthetics with comfortable handling.

With 2 fountain pens included, you can keep different colours ready for different writing purposes or enjoy the convenience of having a second pen for your creative work.

18 Ink Shades of Creativity

Every set includes 18 vibrant ink cartridges, offering a versatile palette ranging from bold primary colours to softer and more expressive shades.

Switch colours according to your mood, project, or personality and bring greater character to everything you write.

Included Ink Shades

  • Yellow × 1

  • Pink × 1

  • Orange × 1

  • Light Blue × 1

  • Dark Purple × 1

  • Light Green × 1

  • Light Purple × 1

  • Brown × 1

  • Red × 2

  • Green × 2

  • Blue × 3

  • Black × 3

Total: 18 Ink Cartridges

Smooth Fine Nib Writing

Both Inkspire fountain pens feature a stainless-steel fine nib designed for smooth, consistent ink flow and controlled writing.

From precise notes and signatures to creative sketches and journal entries, the fine nib delivers an elegant writing experience with every stroke.

Comfortable & Versatile Writing

The textured grip provides a secure and comfortable hold, while the balanced design allows for controlled writing during everyday use.

The set is equally suited for professional writing, journaling, creative expression, sketching, studying, and signatures.

Convenient Ink System

The set comes with 18 ready-to-use ink cartridges, allowing you to easily switch between different shades and keep your favourite colours close at hand.

With two Inkspire fountain pens, you can use different colours simultaneously and create your own personalised writing setup.

Some writing instruments carry a story that begins long before the first stroke. ÆTERNA begins in nature—with carefully selected wood shaped by time, grain, and the quiet character of the material itself.

Each Aeterna Midnight Aegean fountain pen is crafted from stabilised wood that undergoes an advanced vacuum stabilisation process. Premium resin is infused deep into the natural wood fibres, enhancing structural integrity while preserving the distinctive grain, texture, and organic beauty of the original material.

Unlike conventional wooden pens, stabilised wood is designed to resist warping, cracking, moisture, and environmental changes, giving ÆTERNA the durability required for years of writing while retaining the character of natural wood.

A Pattern That Can Never Be Repeated

Every piece of wood develops its own story over decades. Its grain flows differently, its textures shift naturally, and no two pieces are ever identical.

The Midnight Aegean variant embraces this individuality with a deep, sophisticated character that allows the natural grain to remain at the heart of the design. Every pen becomes a visual original—one of one.

At the writing end, a Fine Nib with Swiss Cross engraving brings precision and refinement to the experience, creating a thoughtful contrast between organic material and engineered craftsmanship.

Created as a Collectible Edition, ÆTERNA is designed for those who value authenticity, natural materials, and objects that become more personal with time.

You don't simply choose an ÆTERNA. You choose a piece of nature that could never be replicated.
